text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, T.M. Opera O called me to
"come witness the most
regal of training
regimens."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea what kind of practice she
normally does... But before I
have time to
really think about it, I arrive at my
destination.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, just in time. Let the training now
commence.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why the surprise? I believe I said we are to
train. Where else would
one go?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, stand back and behold.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: One, two, aaaand... THREE!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah! I dance as beautifully as a swan!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: At times elegant... At times dramatic! That's the cue for the thunder—baboom!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Opera O's performance continues as I
stand there mystified...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What does any of this have to do with
training?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That should do it. Go ahead—you
may now give your rave
review.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Wha... Were you even watching?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, no need to fret. You understandably
need time to take in my
artistic vision.
Now, on to my next training!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The water is clear as a gleaming diamond...
It's as if my coming has
been blessed.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do you not see? I must strike the perfect
midair pose... Await my
glory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While her words are still unraveling in my
mind, Opera O climbs the
diving board
and leaps from the top!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hark! What dances through the skies with
the grace of a swallow? 'Tis
I!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaahaha! I hope my radiance didn't blind
you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... The final stop on today's training tour lies just atop this staircase!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And we have arrived!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, we're making a visit to the
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clink!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
May my beauty fill the whole world with
happiness...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
May my beauty fill the whole world with
happiness!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That is how we say our prayers at the
shrine.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's hurry back to school before the
heavens grow wrathful in
their envy of me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her unique style of preparation
completed, we've returned to
the
academy. Maybe now we can get to some
actual work...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what a worthwhile day of training
it's been.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What say you? Having spent the day
together, have you come to
comprehend
my brilliance?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Normal training? My naive friend, that was my normal training.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A cut above the rest, to be sure. For that
is what one must shoulder as
the Centurial
Overlord.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be completely serious, but
could that really be how she
wants to
train?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You appear to have something to say. Go
on, I shall grant you the
chance.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that goes without saying. Perhaps at
this very moment, you're
thinking...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"You won't win if you don't take training
seriously. You'll never be
Overlord."

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then let me tell you this, Trainer. I am always serious.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And this is the optimum training for a ruler.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's filled with such shameless confidence
that there's nothing I can
say otherwise.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You seem unconvinced...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A terrible shame—I'm afraid we'll have to
call off our provisional
arrangement. I
require a trainer willing to follow me to my
dreams.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for taking up your time. May we
meet again someday.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, off to a fine rose bath to wash away
the fatigue of hard work!
Haaah ha ha ha
ha ha hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M Opera O makes a grand departure,
but doesn't seem to have
been offended.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch her go, a tinge of regret comes
over me. Maybe I shouldn't
have spoken
that way...
